description: This Java class defines a Fragment called LogFragment that displays a LogView inside a ScrollView, handling log output and auto-scrolling behavior.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that contains a LogView for displaying logs with auto-scroll functionality.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styles, padding, and gravity.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on text changes, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used within the fragment.
